description: Land Title Settlement Department - Sitinamaluwa, Beliatta D/S Division, Hambantota District - Cad. Map No. 830116 (23/0868)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and encumbrances. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
